title: Studies and experiments: what can you conclude?
hook: Random assignment lets you claim cause. Random sampling lets you generalize.

steps.prompt: From memory: what's the difference between random sampling and random assignment?
steps.answer: Random sampling chooses who is studied, so results generalize to the population. Random assignment puts subjects into groups at random, so you can conclude cause and effect.

steps.prompt: Researchers randomly assign 100 volunteers to drink green tea or not, and the tea group loses more weight. What can they conclude?
choices: Green tea caused more weight loss for these volunteers, but it may not apply to everyone
Green tea causes weight loss in all people
steps.why: Random assignment supports cause; volunteers aren't a random sample, so it may not generalize.

steps.prompt: A survey finds students who sleep more have higher grades. Nothing was assigned. What can you conclude?
choices: There's an association, not necessarily cause
steps.why: Without random assignment, other factors could explain both.

cards.text: Volunteers randomly assigned to use a study app scored higher
A survey: students who sleep more have higher grades
Towns with parks have healthier people
Plants randomly given fertilizer grew taller

steps.why: Only random assignment rules out other explanations, so only experiments can show cause.

steps.prompt: Design a strong study of "Does a study app raise scores?" Put the steps in order.
items: Pick a random sample from the population
Randomly assign them to use the app or not
Measure scores after the same amount of time
steps.why: Random sampling, then random assignment, then a fair comparison.

steps.prompt: A gym surveys its own members about exercise habits. What's the main problem?
choices: The sample doesn't represent the general population
steps.why: Gym members exercise more than most people.

steps.prompt: A study randomly selects 500 adults nationwide and randomly assigns half to a new diet. Tap the false statement.
lines: The results can generalize to adults nationwide
The diet's effect can be called causal
Because it's random, the results are certain
It used both random sampling and random assignment
steps.why: Randomness supports the conclusions, but there's always some uncertainty.
